H7600.def: from «07599»; secure; in a bad sense, haughty:--that is at ease, quiet, tumult. Compare «07946».

H7602.def: a primitive root; to inhale eagerly; figuratively, to cover; by implication, to be angry; also to hasten:--desire (earnestly), devour, haste, pant, snuff up, swallow up.

H7603.def: from «07604»; barm or yeast-cake (as swelling by fermentation):--leaven.

H7604.def: a primitive root; properly, to swell up, i.e. be (causatively, make) redundant:--leave, (be) left, let, remain, remnant, reserve, the rest.

H7605.def: from «07604»; a remainder:--X other, remnant, residue, rest.

H7606.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07605»:--X whatsoever more, residue, rest.

H7607.def: from «07604»; flesh (as swelling out), as living or for food; generally food of any kind; figuratively, kindred by blood:-- body, flesh, food, (near) kin(-sman, -swoman), near (nigh) (of kin).

H7608.def: feminine of «07607»; female kindred by blood:--near kinswomen.

H7609.def: the same as «07608»; Sheerah, an Israelitess:--Sherah.

H7610.def: from «07605» and «07725»; a remnant will return; Shear-Jashub, the symbolic name of one of Isaiah's sons:--Shear-jashub.

H7611.def: from «07604»; a remainder or residual (surviving, final) portion:--that had escaped, be left, posterity, remain(-der), remnant, residue, rest.

H7613.def: from «05375»; an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character:-- be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.

H7614.def: of foreign origin; Sheba, the name of three early progenitors of tribes and of an Ethiopian district:--Sheba, Sabeans.

H7615.def: patronymic from «07614»; a Shebaite or descendant of Sheba:--Sabean.

H7616.et: from an unused root meaning to break up
H7616.def: from an unused root meaning to break up; a fragment, i.e. ruin:--broken in pieces.

H7617.def: a primitive root; to transport into captivity:--(bring away, carry, carry away, lead, lead away, take) captive(-s), drive (take) away.

H7618.et: from an unused root (probably identical with that of (07617) through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers [compare (07632)] meaning to flame
H7618.def: from an unused root (probably identical with that of 7617 through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers (compare «07632») meaning to flame; a gem (from its sparkle), probably the agate:--agate.

H7619.def: or Shuwbanel {shoo-baw-ale'}; from «07617» (abbrev.) or «07725» and «0410»; captive (or returned) of God; Shebuel or Shubael, the name of two Israelites:--Shebuel, Shubael.

H7620.et: properly, pass part of (07650) as a denom. of (07651)
H7620.def: or shabuan {shaw-boo'-ah}; also (feminine) shbu.ah {sheb-oo-aw'}; properly, passive participle of «07650» as a denominative of «07651»; literal, sevened, i.e. a week (specifically, of years):--seven, week.

H7621.def: feminine passive participle of «07650»; properly, something sworn, i.e. an oath:--curse, oath, × sworn.

H7622.def: or shbiyth {sheb-eeth'}; from «07617»; exile, concretely, prisoners; figuratively, a former state of prosperity:-- captive(-ity).

H7623.def: a primitive root; properly, to address in a loud tone, i.e. (specifically) loud; figuratively, to pacify (as if by words):--commend, glory, keep in, praise, still, triumph.

H7624.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07623»; to adulate, i.e. adore:--praise.

H7626.et: from an unused root probably meaning to branch off
H7626.def: from an unused root probably meaning to branch off; a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan:--X correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.

H7627.def: of foreign origin; Shebat, a Jewish month:--Sebat.

H7628.def: from «07618»; exiled; captured; as noun, exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively); by extension, booty:--captive(-ity), prisoners, × take away, that was taken.

H7632.def: from the same as «07616»; flame (as split into tongues):--spark.

H7633.def: feminine of «07628»; exile (abstractly or concretely and collectively):--captives(-ity).

H7634.def: feminine of the same as «07629»; captivation; Shobjah, an Israelite:--Shachia (from the margin).

H7635.def: from the same as «07640»; a track or passage-way (as if flowing along):--path.

H7636.et: from an unused root meaning to interweave
H7636.def: from an unused root meaning to interweave; a netting for the hair:--caul.

H7637.def: or shbi iy {sheb-ee-ee'}; ordinal from «07657»; seventh:--seventh (time).

H7638.et: from an unused root meaning to entwine
H7638.def: from an unused root meaning to intwine; a netting (ornament to the capital of a column):--net.

H7639.def: feminine of «07638»; a net-work, i.e (in hunting) a snare, (in architecture) a ballustrade; also a reticulated ornament to a pillar:--checker, lattice, network, snare, wreath(-enwork).

H7640.et: from an unused root meaning to flow
H7640.def: from an unused root meaning to flow; a lady's train (as trailing after her):--leg.

H7641.et: from the same as (07640), a stream (as flowing)
H7641.def: or (feminine) shibboleth {shib-bo'-leth}; from the same as «07640»; a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch:--branch, channel, ear (of corn), ((water-))flood, Shibboleth. Compare «05451».

H7642.def: from the same as «07640»; a snail (as if floating in its own slime):--snail.

H7643.def: or (feminine) Sibmah {sib-maw'}; probably from «01313»; spice; Sebam or Sibmah, a place in Moab:--Shebam, Shibmah, Sibmah.

H7644.et: from an unused root meaning to grow
H7644.def: : or Shebnah {sheb-naw'}; from an unused root meaning to grow; growth; Shebna or Shebnah, an Israelite:--Shebna, Shebnah.

H7645.def: or Shbanyahuw {sheb-an-yaw'-hoo}; from the same as «07644» and «03050»; Jah has grown (i.e. prospered); Shebanjah, the name of three or four Israelites:--Shebaniah.

H7646.def: or sabeay {saw-bay'-ah}; a primitive root; to sate, i.e. fill to satisfaction (literally or figuratively):--have enough, fill (full, self, with), be (to the) full (of), have plenty of, be satiate, satisfy (with), suffice, be weary of.

H7648.def: from «07646»; satisfaction (of food or (figuratively) joy):--fill, full(-ness), satisfying, be satisfied.

H7649.pos:
1. sated, satisfied, surfeited
    1. sated, abounding, satisfied
    2. surfeited (bad sense)
H7649.def: from «07646»; satiated (in a pleasant or disagreeable sense):--full (of), satisfied (with).

H7650.pos:
1. to swear, adjure
    1. (Qal) sworn (participle)
    2. (Niphal)
      1. to swear, take an oath
      2. to swear (of Jehovah by Himself)
      3. to curse
    3. (Hiphil)
      1. to cause to take an oath
      2. to adjure
H7650.def: a primitive root; propr. to be complete, but used only as a denominative from «07651»; to seven oneself, i.e. swear (as if by repeating a declaration seven times):--adjure, charge (by an oath, with an oath), feed to the full (by mistake for «07646»), take an oath, × straitly, (cause to, make to) swear.

H7651.def: or (masculine) shibrah {shib-aw'}; from «07650»; a primitive cardinal number; seven (as the sacred full one); also (adverbially) seven times; by implication, a week; by extension, an indefinite number:--(+ by) seven(-fold),-s, (-teen, -teenth), -th, times). Compare «07658».

H7652.def: the same as «07651»; seven; Sheba, the name of a place in Palestine, and of two Israelites:--Sheba.

H7654.def: feminine of «07648»; satiety:--(to have) enough, × till...be full, (un-)satiable, satisfy, × sufficiently.

H7656.def: masculine of «07651»; seven(-th); Shebah, a well in Palestine:--Shebah.

H7657.def: multiple of «07651»; seventy:--seventy, threescore and ten (+ -teen).

H7658.def: prol. for the masculine of «07651»; seven:--seven.

H7660.def: a primitive root; to interweave (colored) threads in squares; by implication (of reticulation) to inchase gems in gold:--embroider, set.

H7662.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to the root of «07733»; to quit, i.e. allow to remain:--leave, let alone.

H7663.def: erroneously shabar (Nehemiah 2:13, «015») {shaw-bar'}; a primitive root; to scrutinize; by implication (of watching) to expect (with hope and patience):--hope, tarry, view, wait.

H7665.def: a primitive root; to burst (literally or figuratively):--break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken((-hearted)), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, × quite, tear, view (by mistake for «07663»).

H7666.def: denominative from «07668»; to deal in grain:--buy, sell.

H7667.def: or sheber {shay'-ber}; from «07665»; a fracture, figuratively, ruin; specifically, a solution (of a dream):--affliction, breach, breaking, broken(-footed, -handed), bruise, crashing, destruction, hurt, interpretation, vexation.

H7668.def: the same as «07667»; grain (as if broken into kernels):--corn, victuals.

H7669.def: the same as «07667»; Sheber, an Israelite:--Sheber.

H7670.def: from «07665»; rupture, i.e. a pang; figuratively, ruin:--breaking, destruction.

H7671.def: plural of «07667»; ruins; Shebarim, a place in Palestine:--Shebarim.

H7672.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07660»; to entangle, i.e. perplex:--be astonished.

H7673.def: a primitive root; to repose, i.e. desist from exertion; used in many implied relations (causative, figurative or specific):--(cause to, let, make to) cease, celebrate, cause (make) to fail, keep (sabbath), suffer to be lacking, leave, put away (down), (make to) rest, rid, still, take away.

H7674.def: from «07673»; rest, interruption, cessation:--cease, sit still, loss of time.

H7675.def: infinitive of «03427»; properly, session; but used also concretely, an abode or locality:--place, seat. Compare «03429».

H7676.def: intensive from «07673»; intermission, i.e (specifically) the Sabbath:--(+ every) sabbath.

H7677.def: from «07676»; a sabbatism or special holiday:--rest, sabbath.

H7678.def: from «07676»; restful; Shabbethai, the name of three Israelites:--Shabbethai.

H7679.et: to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (fig) laud
H7679.def: : a primitive root; to grow, i.e. (causatively) to enlarge, (figuratively) laud:--increase, magnify.

H7680.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07679»; to increase:--grow, be multiplied.

H7681.def: probably from «07686»; erring; Shage, an Israelite:--Shage.

H7682.def: a primitive root; to be (causatively, make) lofty, especially inaccessible; by implication, safe, strong; used literally and figuratively --defend, exalt, be excellent, (be, set on) high, lofty, be safe, set up (on high), be too strong.

H7683.def: a primitive root; to stray, i.e. (figuratively) sin (with more or less apology):--X also for that, deceived, err, go astray, sin ignorantly.

H7684.def: from «07683»; a mistake or inadvertent transgression:--error, ignorance, at unawares; unwittingly.

H7685.def: a primitive root; to enlarge (especially upward, also figuratively):--grow (up), increase.

H7686.def: a primitive root; to stray (causatively, mislead), usually (figuratively) to mistake, especially (morally) to transgress; by extension (through the idea of intoxication) to reel, (figuratively) be enraptured:--(cause to) go astray, deceive, err, be ravished, sin through ignorance, (let, make to) wander.

H7687.def: from «07682»; aloft; Segub, the name of two Israelites:--Segub.

H7688.def: a primitive root; to peep, i.e. glance sharply at:--look (narrowly).

H7690.def: (Aramaic) corresponding to «07689»; large (in size, quantity or number, also adverbial):--exceeding, great(-ly); many, much, sore, very.

H7692.def: or shiggayonah {shig-gaw-yo-naw'}; from «07686»; properly, aberration, i.e. (technically) a dithyramb or rambling poem:--Shiggaion, Shigionoth.

H7693.def: a primitive root; to copulate with:--lie with, ravish.

H7696.def: a primitive root; to rave through insanity:--(be, play the) mad (man).

H7698.et: from an unused root probably meaning to eject
H7698.def: from an unused root probably meaning to eject; the fetus (as finally expelled):--that cometh of, increase.

H7699.et: probably from (07736) (in its original sense) contracted
H7699.def: or shod {shode}; probably from «07736» (in its original sense) contracted; the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging):--breast, pap, teat.
